subject: Money
title: Exchange Hacks
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Exchange Hacks.

hook.text: Mt. Gox handled 70% of all Bitcoin trades in 2013. Hackers stole 850,000 Bitcoin. It took 10 years to return anything.

buildup.text: Crypto exchanges are prime hacking targets. They hold billions in digital assets behind potentially vulnerable code.

discovery.text: Over $6 billion has been stolen from exchanges since 2011. Some repaid users. Many simply shut down.

twist.text: Cold storage—keeping crypto offline—prevents hacks. But exchanges need funds online for trading. A constant tension.

climax.text: Hardware wallets let you hold crypto yourself. If you don't trust exchanges with your savings, don't leave it there.

punchline.text: Hack the exchange, steal from everyone at once.

quiz.question: How much has been stolen from crypto exchanges since 2011?
